Dear Paul:
My staff has reviewed the draft environmental statement on H.R. 1311, Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972, and we submit the following comments:
will cooperate to the fullest with the Department of the Interior in establishing sanctuaries for endangered species. However, the Department of Natural Resources is required to operate within the framework of House Bill No. 482, which was passed in the Second Extraordinary Session of the 42nd Legislature. The purpose of this act is to "establish a state system of natural area preserves and means whereby the preservation of these aquatic and land areas can be accomplished." This bill further states that the appropriate state land trust will be paid the fair market value for any interests that are disposed of. All transactions are subject to approval of the Board of Natural Resources.
Thank you for giving us an opportunity to comment on this proposed legislation.
Sincerely,
Bert L. Cole
Commissioner of Public Lands
